title: The docs check for the rollback order accepts any sentence naming rollback, api, stream and worker
notes: TestRunningMdGivesTheUpgradeAndRollbackOrderForWorkersStreamAndApi passed a rollback order that left the old api with no old worker (fixed in the fix round). Pin the order, not the words. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
